    11→var azureStorage = builder
    12→  .AddAzureStorage(Consts.AzureStorage)
    13→  .RunAsEmulator(); // Do not set the persistent lifetime for emulator usage; the clustering will not work.
    14→
    15→var azureClusteringTable = azureStorage.AddTables(Consts.ClusteringServiceClient);
    16→var azureGrainStorageTable = azureStorage.AddTables(Consts.GrainStateServiceClient);
    17→
    18→// Add the Orleans resource to the Aspire DistributedApplication
    19→// builder, then configure it with Azure Table Storage for clustering and grain storage.
    20→
    21→// See: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/aspire/frameworks/orleans?tabs=dotnet-cli
    22→var orleansService = builder
    23→  .AddOrleans("orleans-service")
    24→  .WithClustering(azureClusteringTable)
    25→  .WithGrainStorage("RayGrainStorage", azureGrainStorageTable);
    26→
    27→

    30→// -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    32→// Add your server project and reference your 'orleans' resource from it.
    33→// It can join the Orleans cluster as a silo.

    36→var silo = builder.AddProject<Projects.Server_Silo>("silo")
    37→  .WithReference(orleansService)

    42→// project so that it can connect to the Orleans cluster.
    43→var api = builder.AddProject<Projects.Server_Api>("api")

### 1. DemoApp.CollaborativeEditor

**Directory Structure:**
```
DemoApp.CollaborativeEditor/

├── App.axaml.cs                           (App initialization)
├── DemoApp.CollaborativeEditor.csproj     (Project file)
├── Program.cs                             (Entry point)

│   └── FormattingState.cs                 (Tracks bold/italic/underline/link at cursor)
├── Services/
│   ├── AutomergeService.cs                (Rich text with marks & blocks)
│   └── SyncService.cs                     (Timer-based bidirectional sync, 500ms interval)
├── ViewModels/
│   ├── EditorViewModel.cs                 (Main view model with text + formatting)
│   └── ViewModelBase.cs                   (ReactiveObject base)
└── Views/
    ├── EditorWindow.axaml                 (Two-pane editor UI)
    └── EditorWindow.axaml.cs              (Code-behind for cursor tracking)
```

**Key Features:**
- **Document Type:** Rich text (Text CRDT) with inline formatting marks (bold, italic, underline, link)
- **AutomergeDocument Creation:** Creates document with root → "content" (Text object)
- **Operations Supported:**
  - `SpliceText(index, deleteCount, insertText)` - Text editing
  - `MarkBold/UnmarkBold/MarkItalic/UnmarkItalic/MarkUnderline/UnmarkUnderline(start, end, bool)`
  - `MarkLink(start, end, url) / UnmarkLink(start, end)`
  - `SplitBlock(index, blockType) / JoinBlock(index)` - Block-level structure
  - `GetMarks()` - Returns list of active marks for formatting toolbar state
  - `GetSpans()` - Segmented text by marks and blocks
  - `GetCursor(index) / GetCursorPosition(cursor)` - Stable cursor positions

**Sync Mechanism:**
- **Method:** Timer-based Fork with bidirectional sync on 500ms interval
- **How it works:**
  1. `AutomergeService.Fork()` creates peer document sharing history
  2. `SyncService` holds two sync states: `_syncLocalToPeer`, `_syncPeerToLocal`
  3. Every 500ms: `GenerateSyncMessage()` → `ReceiveSyncMessage()` exchange (up to 10 loops per round)
  4. `SimulatePeerEdit()` manually adds text to peer, triggers `PeerEdited` event
  5. UI updates via `OnSyncCompleted` event on timer thread, marshaled to UI thread via `Dispatcher.UIThread.Post()`

**UI Structure:**
- **Two-pane split layout:**
  - Left: Local document (editable TextBox with two-way binding to `DocumentText`)
  - Right: Read-only peer document view
- **Toolbar:**
  - Bold/Italic/Underline toggle buttons (state bound to `IsBold`, `IsItalic`, `IsUnderline`)
  - "Simulate Peer Edit" button
  - "Save" button
  - "Toggle Sync" button
- **Status bar:** Shows sync status, peer count, cursor position, selection length
- **Formatting applied via marks on text ranges** (not character-level properties)

**Data Binding:**
- `DocumentText` ↔ TextBox text (TwoWay)
- `CursorPosition` ↔ TextBox CaretIndex (TwoWay)
- `IsBold/IsItalic/IsUnderline` → ToggleButton.IsChecked (OneWay)
- `PeerText` (read-only) → Peer TextBox text

**Project References:**
- `Ray.Automerge.csproj` (high-level C# API)
- `Ray.Automerge.Repo.csproj` (document lifecycle, sync)

**Migration to Repo Pattern with SignalR:**
- Remove `SyncService` timer-based fork mechanism
- Integrate `INetworkAdapter` (SignalR implementation) for peer communication
- Replace fork-based sync with Repo's `DocSynchronizer` (handles multi-peer sync protocol)
- Change UI to read from `DocHandle` events instead of `SyncCompleted` event
- Network transport: SignalR hub instead of in-process timer sync
- Storage: Potentially add `IStorageAdapter` for persistence

---

**Sync Mechanism:**
- **Method:** Timer-based Fork (identical to CollaborativeEditor)
- **Difference:** No formatting state to track, simpler sync

## Comprehensive Exploration Report: Four Demo Avalonia Apps

### 1. DemoApp.CollaborativeEditor

**Directory Structure:**
```
DemoApp.CollaborativeEditor/
├── App.axaml                              (Fluent theme application definition)
├── App.axaml.cs                           (App initialization)
├── DemoApp.CollaborativeEditor.csproj     (Project file)
├── Program.cs                             (Entry point)
├── Models/
│   └── FormattingState.cs                 (Tracks bold/italic/underline/link at cursor)
├── Services/
│   ├── AutomergeService.cs                (Rich text with marks & blocks)
│   └── SyncService.cs                     (Timer-based bidirectional sync, 500ms interval)
├── ViewModels/
│   ├── EditorViewModel.cs                 (Main view model with text + formatting)
│   └── ViewModelBase.cs                   (ReactiveObject base)
└── Views/
    ├── EditorWindow.axaml                 (Two-pane editor UI)
    └── EditorWindow.axaml.cs              (Code-behind for cursor tracking)
```

**Key Features:**
- **Document Type:** Rich text (Text CRDT) with inline formatting marks (bold, italic, underline, link)
- **AutomergeDocument Creation:** Creates document with root → "content" (Text object)
- **Operations Supported:**
  - `SpliceText(index, deleteCount, insertText)` - Text editing
  - `MarkBold/UnmarkBold/MarkItalic/UnmarkItalic/MarkUnderline/UnmarkUnderline(start, end, bool)`
  - `MarkLink(start, end, url) / UnmarkLink(start, end)`
  - `SplitBlock(index, blockType) / JoinBlock(index)` - Block-level structure
  - `GetMarks()` - Returns list of active marks for formatting toolbar state
  - `GetSpans()` - Segmented text by marks and blocks
  - `GetCursor(index) / GetCursorPosition(cursor)` - Stable cursor positions

**Sync Mechanism:**
- **Method:** Timer-based Fork with bidirectional sync on 500ms interval
- **How it works:**
  1. `AutomergeService.Fork()` creates peer document sharing history
  2. `SyncService` holds two sync states: `_syncLocalToPeer`, `_syncPeerToLocal`
  3. Every 500ms: `GenerateSyncMessage()` → `ReceiveSyncMessage()` exchange (up to 10 loops per round)
  4. `SimulatePeerEdit()` manually adds text to peer, triggers `PeerEdited` event
  5. UI updates via `OnSyncCompleted` event on timer thread, marshaled to UI thread via `Dispatcher.UIThread.Post()`

**UI Structure:**
- **Two-pane split layout:**
  - Left: Local document (editable TextBox with two-way binding to `DocumentText`)
  - Right: Read-only peer document view
- **Toolbar:**
  - Bold/Italic/Underline toggle buttons (state bound to `IsBold`, `IsItalic`, `IsUnderline`)
  - "Simulate Peer Edit" button
  - "Save" button
  - "Toggle Sync" button
- **Status bar:** Shows sync status, peer count, cursor position, selection length
- **Formatting applied via marks on text ranges** (not character-level properties)

**Data Binding:**
- `DocumentText` ↔ TextBox text (TwoWay)
- `CursorPosition` ↔ TextBox CaretIndex (TwoWay)
- `IsBold/IsItalic/IsUnderline` → ToggleButton.IsChecked (OneWay)
- `PeerText` (read-only) → Peer TextBox text

**Project References:**
- `Ray.Automerge.csproj` (high-level C# API)
- `Ray.Automerge.Repo.csproj` (document lifecycle, sync)

**Migration to Repo Pattern with SignalR:**
- Remove `SyncService` timer-based fork mechanism
- Integrate `INetworkAdapter` (SignalR implementation) for peer communication
- Replace fork-based sync with Repo's `DocSynchronizer` (handles multi-peer sync protocol)
- Change UI to read from `DocHandle` events instead of `SyncCompleted` event
- Network transport: SignalR hub instead of in-process timer sync
- Storage: Potentially add `IStorageAdapter` for persistence

## Common Patterns Across All Apps

1. **Project Structure:**
   - `Services/AutomergeService.cs` - CRDT operations wrapper
   - `Services/SyncService.cs` (except TaskBoard) - Timer-based sync with fork
   - `ViewModels/` - ReactiveUI ViewModelBase
   - `Models/` - Data containers
   - `Views/` - XAML + code-behind

2. **Document Lifecycle:**
   - Create: `AutomergeDocument.Create()`
   - Write: Put/splice operations, then `Commit(message)`
   - Sync: `CreateSyncState()`, `GenerateSyncMessage()`, `ReceiveSyncMessage()`
   - Save: `Save()` → byte array
   - Load: `Load(byte[])` → restored doc

3. **UI Pattern:**
   - Toolbar with action buttons
   - Status bar with live stats
   - Main content area (text, canvas, or board)
   - Reactive property binding to ViewModel

4. **Automerge API Usage:**
   - Map operations: `PutString`, `PutBoolean`, `PutDouble`, `PutInt64`, `PutCounter`, `PutObject`
   - List operations: `ListInsertObject`, `ListGetObject`, `ListRemove`, `ListLength`
   - Text operations: `SpliceText`, `GetText`, `Mark/Unmark`
   - Sync: `CreateSyncState()`, `GenerateSyncMessage()`, `ReceiveSyncMessage()`
   - Metadata: `GetString`, `GetObject`, `GetBoolean`, `GetDouble`, `GetInt64`, `GetCounter`

5. **What Would Change for Repo Pattern + SignalR:**
   - Replace `SyncService` timer with `Repo.CreateDocumentAsync()`
   - Replace manual sync with `DocSynchronizer` (handles multi-peer sync protocol)
   - Replace in-process fork with network-based peer concept

   - Add `IStorageAdapter` (FileSystem or InMemory) for persistence
   - Events: Replace `SyncCompleted` with `DocHandle.Change` event
   - No need to expose `AutomergeDocument` directly—use `DocHandle` API

### 4. SignalR Network Infrastructure

#### **Client Side** (libs/Ray.Automerge.Repo.Network.SignalR.Client)

**SignalRNetworkAdapter** (`SignalRNetworkAdapter.cs`):
- Implements `INetworkAdapter` interface for Repo
- Manages HubConnection lifecycle with semaphore-based thread safety
- **Key Methods:**
  - `Connect(peerId, metadata)`: Connects to hub, sends handshake, marks ready
  - `Send(message)`: Auto-subscribes to document, sends sync/request/snapshot messages
  - `SubscribeToDocumentAsync(documentId)`: Explicitly subscribe to document group
  - `UnsubscribeFromDocumentAsync(documentId)`: Unsubscribe from group
  - `Disconnect()`: Graceful cleanup with unsubscribe-all
- **Events Raised:**
  - `PeerCandidate`: Triggered on handshake and peer join notifications
  - `PeerDisconnected`: Triggered on disconnect
  - `MessageReceived`: Deferred to Task.Run() to avoid blocking SignalR thread
  - `Closed`: Raised on connection close
- **Message Deserialization:** Converts `MessageDto` to `IRepoMessage` (supports sync, request, snapshot, doc-unavailable; ephemeral and remote-heads-changed not fully supported)
- **Echo Prevention:** Senders don't receive their own messages (hub routes to `OthersInGroup`)

**SignalRConnectionService** (`SignalRConnectionService.cs`):
- Factory for HubConnection with lifecycle management
- **Supports:**
  - MessagePack protocol with LZ4 block compression (default)
  - JSON protocol fallback
  - Automatic reconnection (configurable)
- **Options:** `SignalRConnectionServiceOptions` (HubUrl, UseMessagePackProtocol, EnableAutomaticReconnect, AutoStart)
- **Keyed Services:** Multiple hubs can be injected with different keys

**SignalRConnectionServiceFactory** (`SignalRConnectionServiceFactory.cs`):
- Test utility for creating connection services with custom hub URLs

**DI Extensions** (`SignalRConnectionServiceExtensions.cs`):
- Registers connection service in DI container with options configuration

#### **Server Side** (libs/Ray.Automerge.Repo.Network.SignalR.Server)

**DocumentsHub** (`DocumentsHub.cs`):
- Inherits from `Hub<IDocumentsHubClient>`
- **Hub Methods (server-to-client):**
  - `Handshake(PeerHandshakeDto)`: Stores peer ID in context, broadcasts join to others
  - `SubscribeToDocument(documentId)`: Adds connection to document group
  - `UnsubscribeFromDocument(documentId)`: Removes connection from document group
  - `SendMessage(MessageDto)`: Auto-subscribes sender, broadcasts to group except sender
- **Client Methods (client-to-server):**
  - `OnPeerJoined(handshake)`
  - `OnPeerLeft(peerId)`
  - `OnReceiveMessage(messageDto)`
- **Lifecycle:**
  - `OnConnectedAsync()`: Logs connection
  - `OnDisconnectedAsync()`: Broadcasts peer-left to all, logs disconnection

**SignalRServerExtensions** (`SignalRServerExtensions.cs`):
- `AddSignalRDocumentsHub()`: Configures SignalR with MessagePack + LZ4 compression + JSON fallback
- `AddSignalRDocumentsHubWithJson()`: JSON-only variant for debugging

# Requirements: Multi-Client Sync Demo Apps

## Overview

All four demo Avalonia applications (CollaborativeEditor, CollaborativeTextEditor, FigmaClone, TaskBoard) must be upgraded from simulated in-process sync to real multi-client synchronization over SignalR, using the Repo pattern with FileSystem storage, orchestrated via .NET Aspire.

## Functional Requirements

### FR-1: Server Infrastructure

- **FR-1.1**: Server.Api must host a SignalR DocumentsHub at `/hubs/documents` using `AddSignalRDocumentsHub()` (MessagePack + LZ4 compression).
- **FR-1.2**: Server.Api must expose a health check endpoint for Aspire readiness.
- **FR-1.3**: CORS policy on Server.Api must allow SignalR WebSocket connections with credentials (change from `AllowAnyOrigin` to specific origins with `AllowCredentials`).

### FR-2: Aspire Orchestration

- **FR-2.1**: AppHost must register all four demo apps with configurable replica counts (default 2 per app).
- **FR-2.2**: All demo apps must have `WithExplicitStart()` so they are started manually from the Aspire dashboard.
- **FR-2.3**: All demo apps must reference Server.Api and wait for it to be ready before connecting.
- **FR-2.4**: Demo apps must receive the Server.Api URL via Aspire service discovery (environment variable injection).
- **FR-2.5**: Demo apps must be excluded from the distributed manifest (they are desktop apps, not services).

### FR-3: Shared App Infrastructure (applies to all four apps)

- **FR-3.1**: Each app must use the `Repo` class with `SignalRNetworkAdapter` and `FileSystemStorageAdapter`.
- **FR-3.2**: Each app instance must generate a unique `PeerId` on startup.
- **FR-3.3**: Each app must display a **Connection Status Panel** showing:
  - Own PeerId (truncated)
  - SignalR connection state (Connecting / Connected / Disconnected / Reconnecting)
  - Number of connected peers
  - Current document ID (copiable to clipboard)
  - Server URL being connected to
- **FR-3.4**: Each app must support two modes:
  - **Create mode**: Create a new document and share the document ID.
  - **Join mode**: Enter an existing document ID (paste from clipboard) to join an existing session.
- **FR-3.5**: Documents must persist across app restarts via FileSystem storage.
- **FR-3.6**: When a remote peer makes changes, the local UI must update within 1 second.
- **FR-3.7**: Remove all existing `SyncService` timer-based fork sync mechanisms.
- **FR-3.8**: Remove all "Simulate Peer Edit" buttons and simulated peer views.

### FR-4: CollaborativeTextEditor

- **FR-4.1**: Single text editing area (remove the two-pane peer simulation layout).
- **FR-4.2**: Text changes via `SpliceText` must propagate to all connected peers in real-time.
- **FR-4.3**: Display current peer count and document ID in status bar.
- **FR-4.4**: Cursor position tracking continues to work locally (no remote cursor display required).

### FR-5: CollaborativeEditor (Rich Text)

- **FR-5.1**: Single editor area (remove the two-pane peer simulation layout).
- **FR-5.2**: Text changes AND formatting marks (bold, italic, underline, link) must propagate to peers.
- **FR-5.3**: Block-level operations (split block, join block) must propagate to peers.
- **FR-5.4**: Formatting toolbar state must reflect the local cursor position (existing behavior preserved).

### FR-6: FigmaClone (Canvas)

- **FR-6.1**: Single shared canvas (remove peer simulation).
- **FR-6.2**: Shape creation, movement, resizing, and color changes must propagate to peers.
- **FR-6.3**: Layer management (add/remove/toggle visibility) must propagate to peers.
- **FR-6.4**: Shape deletion must propagate to peers.
- **FR-6.5**: Canvas must refresh from CRDT state when remote changes arrive (re-read shapes/layers).

### FR-7: TaskBoard (Kanban)

- **FR-7.1**: Add sync capability (currently has none).
- **FR-7.2**: Column creation, deletion, and renaming must propagate to peers.
- **FR-7.3**: Task creation, deletion, and cross-column moves must propagate to peers.
- **FR-7.4**: Vote counter increments must merge correctly across peers (CRDT counter).
- **FR-7.5**: Board must refresh from CRDT state when remote changes arrive.

### FR-8: App Lifecycle

- **FR-8.1**: Apps must gracefully handle SignalR disconnection and reconnection.
- **FR-8.2**: Apps must dispose of Repo, network adapter, and storage adapter on shutdown.
- **FR-8.3**: On startup, if a previously persisted document exists, the app must offer to resume it.

## Non-Functional Requirements

### NFR-1: Performance
- Sync latency must be under 500ms for typical operations (text edit, shape move, task change) on localhost.
- FileSystem storage must use incremental saves (not full snapshots on every change).

### NFR-2: Reliability
- Apps must handle server unavailability gracefully (show disconnected state, queue local changes).
- SignalR automatic reconnection must be enabled.

### NFR-3: Code Quality
- Follow existing project conventions: StyleCop, 2-space indentation, file-scoped namespaces.
- Use `[PublicAPI]` attribute on public API surfaces.
- All new services must be injectable via DI where appropriate.
- ViewModels must use ReactiveUI patterns (consistent with existing codebase).

### NFR-4: Testability
- The shared sync infrastructure (RepoService) must be testable with InMemory adapters.
- Each app must be runnable and testable via `six-avalonia-mcp` MCP tools.

### NFR-5: Developer Experience
- Running `dotnet run --project apps/Infra.AppHost` must start the full stack.
- From the Aspire dashboard, starting any demo app replica must work without manual configuration.
- Document IDs must be easily copyable between app instances for joining sessions.
